summary: ASX -0.62% to 8911.1 in a risk-off session on a hawkish read of new Fed chair Warsh's debut; tape broadly red (Adv/Dec 56/133) but masked by defensive large-caps. Uranium specs surged (CXU +33%) while gold miners were dumped (OBM -7.53%, PNR -6.56% both ASX200) on bullion consolidation. WTI fell to ~$74 on IEA glut + signed US-Iran deal. RBA held 4.35% Tuesday (unanimous), CPI eased to 4.2%.
